D002.name: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)
D002.icd10_name: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, predominantly inattentive type

D003.name: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Hyperactive/Impulsive Presentation)
D003.icd10_name: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, predominantly hyperactive type

D008.name: Bipolar I Disorder
D008.note: DSM-5 assigns a distinct ICD-10-CM code per current/most recent episode type and severity (e.g., F31.1x manic, F31.3x-F31.5 depressed, F31.6x mixed, F31.7x in remission). F31.9 is used here as the generic/unspecified default.

D010.name: Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
D010.icd10_name: Bipolar disorder, current episode manic severe with psychotic features
D010.note: Represents the manic-with-psychotic-features presentation; a depressive episode with psychotic features would instead map to F31.5.

D012.name: Specific Phobia
D012.note: DSM-5-CM requires a subtype-specific code (e.g., F40.218 animal type, F40.228 natural environment type, F40.230-F40.233 blood-injection-injury type, F40.248 situational type, F40.298 other type). F40.9 is used here as the generic/unspecified default.

D013.name: Major Depressive Disorder
D013.icd10_name: Major depressive disorder, single episode, unspecified
D013.note: Recurrent presentations map to F33.x instead (e.g., F33.9 recurrent, unspecified).

D015.name: Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
D015.icd10_name: Major depressive disorder, single episode, severe with psychotic features
D015.note: Recurrent presentations map to F33.3 instead.

D020.name: Adjustment Disorder
D020.note: Subtypes exist (e.g., F43.21 with depressed mood, F43.22 with anxiety, F43.23 with mixed anxiety and depressed mood, F43.24 with disturbance of conduct, F43.25 with mixed disturbance of emotions and conduct).

D021.name: Anorexia Nervosa
D021.note: Subtypes: F50.01 restricting type, F50.02 binge-eating/purging type.
